knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Before a finding is classed as a service defect, the inspector confirms the agreed acceptance criterion and the exact location, checked against the correct work-order version. Whether the cleaner is available for questions, or whether a photo looks clean, does not establish a defect.
Evidence is proportionate and privacy-safe. Full photos that expose client information are not kept or shared outside the approved system.

A corrective action is closed only after it has been reinspected against the same criterion, with the completion recorded and the closeout step documented. Client silence, a worker's word or a photograph does not close it.

practicalCriteria: Learner inspects a supplied area along a fixed route, recording each checklist item as it is checked.
Learner classifies each defect in the area using the business definitions and describes it in observable terms.
Learner completes an evidence record in which a second inspector could repeat the inspection, and any note written after the event is dated.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Supervisor-completed practical record with each criterion marked
Worker's inspection record for the practical area
stopWorkCriteria: Learner works in a restricted area or at height without the access and permit the site requires
